questions.s:

o: The relative charge of a proton is equal but opposite in sign to the relative charge of an electron.

The relative mass of an electron is about 2000 times the relative mass of a neutron.

questions.s: Which statement about isotopes is correct?
o: They have different numbers of electrons and react differently in chemical reactions.
They have the same number of neutrons and exhibit identical chemical and physical properties.
They have different mass numbers but undergo the same chemical reactions.
They have different proton numbers and belong to different elements.

Which statement about the Haber process for the manufacture of ammonia is correct?
o: At higher temperatures, the yield increases and the rate of production of ammonia is faster.
At higher pressure, the yield increases and the rate of production of ammonia is faster.
In the presence of a catalyst, the yield decreases but the rate of production of ammonia is faster.
In the presence of a catalyst, the yield increases and the rate of production of ammonia is faster.

questions.s:

Properties of an element and its compounds can be predicted from the position of the element in the Periodic Table.

o: The acidic or basic nature of its oxide.
The number of valence electrons in its atoms.
The number of isotopes it has.

questions.s:
Rubidium is a Group 1 metal located below potassium in the Periodic Table.
Which statement is correct?
o: Rubidium is less dense than potassium.
Rubidium has a higher melting point than potassium.
Rubidium reacts more explosively with water than potassium.
Rubidium chloride is insoluble while potassium chloride is soluble.

questions.s: Which deduction about the element astatine, At, can be made from its position in Group 17?
o: It is more reactive than iodine.
It forms covalent compounds with sodium.
It is displaced from aqueous potassium astatide, KAt, by chlorine.

questions.s:
Iron and copper are widely used as industrial catalysts.
Which statement explains why this is so?
o: Their compounds have low melting points and are easily decomposed.
They form ions with variable oxidation states that can participate in redox reactions.
They are in the same group of the Periodic Table and react readily with acids.
They are coloured metals that do not form oxides easily.

questions.s: Why is argon commonly used to fill electric light bulbs to prolong the life of the wire filament?
o: Argon is a dense air that cools the filament rapidly.
Argon conducts electricity and increases the efficiency of the filament.
Argon is chemically unreactive and prevents oxidation of the filament.
Argon reacts with oxygen, forming a protective oxide coating.

questions.s:
A metal oxide cannot be reduced by either carbon or hydrogen.
Which statement is correct?
o: The metal is more reactive than carbon and hydrogen and must be extracted by electrolysis.
The metal is less reactive than carbon and can be extracted by heating with carbon.
The metal is less reactive than hydrogen and can be found uncombined in nature.
The metal is more reactive than hydrogen but less reactive than carbon, so should be reduced using hydrogen.
